reviews.author: Rosario Sagastume
reviews.text: Excellent customer service, Honest, Respectful, Very helpful, with a sense of responsibility making sure my safety was his priority, took his time to work on the steps to loose the spare tire came to be difficult because I didn't have the right tools at the moment so he remove the rip off tire and went to a place to get a new one for my car, after installing the tire he notice it was damaged so he asked me to fallow him to the place to replace the tire for a good one. Overall everything was at a reasonably priced. 100% recommended.
